compute_so3_geodesic_distance: compute the geodesic distance between two sets of SO(3) rotation matrices using quaternions
compute_verts_euclidean_distance: compute the pairwise Euclidean distance between two sets of 3D vertex coordinates
calculate_pose_distance: calculate pose distance between two sets of poses using either vertex or rotation metrics
run_kmedoids_clustering: run K-Medoids clustering on a precomputed 2D distance matrix and return labels and medoid indices
split_train_val_test: split pose data into train, in-distribution val, out-of-distribution val, and test sets using clustering
